layers.label: Peak hour
layers.question: When does it peak?
layers.note: Hour-of-day of peak. The quickstart calls this UTC, but measured evidence points to local time: the API returned 16-17 for Phoenix, while env_params for the same day reports GMT-7 with apparent temperature peaking at 15:00 local. A UTC reading would imply a 09:00 local peak, which is not credible in Phoenix in July. Treated as local hour; no conversion applied.
